Subject: Assurance stack walkthrough request — SIG + ISO follow-ups

Mina,

Thanks for taking this on. As part of SecureBank's evaluation for a core inference provider we need a short walkthrough (45–60 minutes) to validate control alignment and collect a small set of artifacts. Our initial RFP asked for a SIG+ISO crosswalk; reviewers have flagged a few open items: key management split, backup retention encryption details, and evidence for SOC 2 controls around change management and segmentation.

Attached: RFP_Security_Questions_v3.pdf (annotated).

High level ask: can you provide a short walkthrough for our security review team next week and a deliverable packet (control crosswalk + artifacts) within five business days after the call?

Preferred attendees from SecureBank: Myself (infosec lead) and Procurement.

Thanks — please propose times.

Lisa Ng
Director, Security Assurance
SecureBank
procurement@securebank.com

Team — forwarding SecureBank's annotated RFP. They want a 45–60m walkthrough and a deliverable pack (crosswalk + artifacts) within five business days post-call. Proposed plan below; confirm owners by EOD so I can reply with a proposed cadence.

Proposed action items (owner):
- KMS architecture diagram + KMS responsibilities (public/private key separation, HSM/KMS type): Karthik
- SOC 2 redacted report + list of control owners for change mgmt, access reviews: Neha
- SIG control crosswalk mapping (SIG control -> Redwood control & evidence location): Jordan
- Draft assurance pack (zip of artifacts, index file, and readme): Mina/Jordan

Timeline: schedule call for next Tue/Wed (Apr 20/21). Deliverable due EOD Fri Apr 23 (5 business days after call). If any ask is infeasible, call it out.

Notes: we should avoid sending raw logs; provide sampled redacted logs and explanations. We'll use the redwood-assurance Drive folder and a DocuSign link only for the non-sensitive AUP signature if required.

Mina Haddad
Head of Security Programs
Redwood Inference

- kms-diagram-2027-04.pdf (architecture, roles, KMS type: AWS KMS + HSM-backed CMKs for customer keys)

Lisa — thanks for the clear notes. We'd be happy to run the walkthrough. Below are proposed times and a short agenda. After you confirm a slot we'll send an invite and the assurance pack.

Proposed times (PT):
- Tue, Apr 20 — 09:00–10:00 or 14:00–15:00
- Wed, Apr 21 — 11:00–12:00

Proposed agenda (45m):
1) Introductions & scope (5m)
2) SIG/ISO crosswalk highlights (10m)
3) KMS & key lifecycle / backups (15m)
4) Evidence package walkthrough and delivery plan (10m)
5) Q&A & next steps (5m)

Planned Redwood attendees: Mina Haddad (Head, Security Programs), Karthik Iyer (Infra), Jordan Blake (Assurance & Evidence), Neha Kapoor (Compliance).

Deliverable: Redwood_Assurance_Pack_v1.zip to be uploaded to Drive post-call; it will include the SIG crosswalk, redacted SOC2, kms diagram, and a README that maps each artifact to SIG controls. We will not provide unredacted logs or PII. If SecureBank needs additional sealed artifacts we can set up an SCIF-style access review call to discuss.

Please confirm a slot and any other attendees.

Best,
